ImageTracer.js vendor directory
================================

Place `imagetracer_v1.2.6.js` in this folder to use the local (offline) fast-path vectorizer.

Download options:
- jsDelivr: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/imagetracerjs@1.2.6/imagetracer_v1.2.6.js
- GitHub: https://github.com/jankovicsandras/imagetracerjs

Path expected by the app:
`assets/vendor/imagetracer_v1.2.6.js`

If the file is not present, the app will fall back to the CDN automatically.
